config.question: head + nested corrections inside the co-moving frame, 32^3 first check

timing.note: CNAB2 comparisons use fast-block medians (all arms interleaved, randomised). FD-CG arms are timed after an idle cool-down; the ladder arms are also timed immediately after the heavy FD-CG neighbour (after_heavy, no cool-down), and FD-CG speedups are reported against both the fast-block and the after-heavy ROM medians, the latter being the conservative one.
